items.headline: 'We Don't Have Decades': Why $500 Million Won't Break China's Grip on Batteries
items.snippet: Albemarle beat Q2 estimates with adjusted EPS of $3.75 on $1.74 billion in revenue, and management now expects to land at the high end of its $20 per kg LCE scenario. That would put full-year sales at $5.7 to $6 billion.

items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: JPMorgan analyst Jeffrey Zekauskas recently cut Albemarle's 2026 adjusted EBITDA estimate by 14.4% to $2.88 billion. Chinese prices averaged about $21,625 a ton so far in the third quarter, down from $24,810 in the second.

items.headline: Albemarle's Lithium Math Turns Brutal
items.snippet: JPMorgan now expects lithium prices to remain in the low-$20-per-kilogram range. Albemarle shares were down 5.16% at $134.21 at the time of publication on Tuesday, according to Benzinga Pro data.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $161 from $189 at Morgan Stanley
items.snippet: Morgan Stanley analyst Vincent Andrews lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $161 from $189 and keeps an Equal Weight rating on the shares.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: RBC has an outperform rating on Albemarle and decreased the company's price target to $157 from $166.
